title: ジャパンカップの後に・頂点へ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week claims victory against El Condor Pasa at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They praise each other over a great race with a firm handshake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, as Special Week heads home, Grass Wonder appears and challenges her to determine who is stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so it is that Special Week steps up to race against Grass Wonder the Beast at the Arima Kinen!
